title: cyclanthera quinqueloba
intro: Cyclanthera quinqueloba, commonly known as the five-angled gourd, is a type of vining plant in the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant is valued for its nutritional and medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting effects. The therapeutic actions of Cyclanthera quinqueloba include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
